correctness.rationale: Skew rewriting gives the eight squarefree PBW monomials and nilpotent augmentation ideal; the scalar part of a square-zero element vanishes. The square has degree-two coefficients (1+t)(ab,ac,bc) and cubic coefficient (1+t²)(af+cd)+2tbe. At t=−1, char(k)≠2, the resulting rank-six split quadric is absolutely irreducible, with radical line as singular locus. At char(k)=2, t=1, all equations vanish. Otherwise at most one linear coordinate is nonzero, and on each axis its complementary quadratic coordinate vanishes exactly when the corresponding mixed coefficient is nonzero. Axis closures and the zero-linear slice give precisely the stated maximal linear components; points on multiple components are singular by their local minimal primes. Disjoint strata give the displayed classes, also for the quadric by a locally trivial affine two-plane bundle over nonzero first triples and the zero-triple fiber separately. For nonzero linear part, graded multiplication ranks 1,2,1 give four independent leading images and L_u²=0 bounds the rank by four. With zero linear part a nonzero quadratic component gives u and the socle as independent images; a pure nonzero cubic has rank one. This yields the whole census and acyclicity assertion. Independently rewrote products and exhaustively checked finite models of all five regimes with python /workspace/review_evidence/reproduce_5.py; for instance F₅,t=2 gives ranks 0,1,2,4 with counts 1,4,620,5500. The proof covers all fields including characteristic zero; the geometry is reduced, and the finite check is not an all-field proof.
